title: 06. Count events by UTC day

examples.explanation: positive offset moves an event to the prior UTC day
negative offset moves an event to the next UTC day

courseHelp.title: Course help
courseHelp.body:
Write your code in the function at the top of the editor. Follow the numbered steps and replace each TODO. Run checks the three examples. Submit checks all cases, including edge cases. Open the hints one at a time if you are stuck.

Keep the adapter class at the bottom unchanged. It reads the input, calls your function, and rejects changes to the input. Python 3.11 and the standard library.

hints: `datetime.fromisoformat(text)` returns a time that knows its offset (an "aware" datetime).
`moment.astimezone(timezone.utc)` converts the time to UTC. Do not use `.replace(tzinfo=...)`: it changes the label, not the time.
